stories.title: B.C. Lions to hold training camp in Langford for next three seasons
stories.summary: As part of the deal, the Lions will play a Canadian Football League pre-season game each of those years to conclude the training camp.

stories.title: B.C. NDP keeps win in Ladysmith-Oceanside after recount
stories.summary: The recount left Stephanie Higginson 47 votes ahead of Conservative candidate Kris McNichol, down from 50 votes.

stories.title: China launches Shenzhou 24 spacecraft carrying 2 Chinese and a Pakistani astronaut
stories.summary: JIUQUAN, China (AP) — China on Wednesday launched the Shenzhou 24 spacecraft with three astronauts — two Chinese and a Pakistani — sending the first foreign crew member to its space station.

stories.title: Crews search for 6 aboard a small plane that crashed into the Gulf of Mexico, Coast Guard says
stories.summary: Rescue crews were searching for six people, including two children, after a small plane went down Tuesday afternoon off the coast of Mississippi, authorities said.

stories.title: Storm surge, king tides converge to raise flooding risk on B.C. coast
stories.summary: VANCOUVER — The risk of flooding is elevated across British Columbia's coast as drenching rain and blustery winds coincide with king tides, setting off widespread warnings.

stories.title: Jaques scores hat trick in Goldeneyes' wild pre-season win over Vanguards
stories.summary: HENDERSON — Defender Sophie Jaques had a hat trick and the Vancouver Goldeneyes outlasted the expansion Vegas Vanguards 8-6 Tuesday in a wild PWHL pre-season game.

stories.title: Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan asks court to delay firing-squad execution so he can fight sentence
stories.summary: KILLEEN, Texas (AP) — Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan, who killed 13 people in an attack at the Texas military base in 2009, asked a federal court Tuesday to delay his execution by firing squad so he can prepare a petition contesting his sentence.

stories.title: Video: Mystery spill in North Vancouver creek results in 'serious' fish kill
stories.summary: North Shore Streamkeepers spot more than 20 dead fish, including spawning salmon, in North Van's Wagg Creek.
